rationale: IEC 60909 positive-sequence short-circuit calculation: summed grid, transformer, and bus duct impedances; maximum current computed with c_max=1.1 and bolted fault (no fault resistance); minimum current computed with c_min=1.0 and fault_resistance_pu=0.005; base current = 100/(√3×10.5) ≈ 5.4982 kA.
